chp_or_dmv.name: California Highway Patrol - Ventura Area
chp_or_dmv.snippet: Located along the scenic coast of Southern California, the Ventura Area of the California Highway Patrol is responsible for patrolling a diverse and expansive region that includes approximately 175 miles of freeway, including state routes and 542 miles of unincorporated roadways within its 1,843 square mile territory. The Ventura Area encompasses a variety of communities, including the city of Ventura, Oxnard, Camarillo, Santa Paula, Ojai and surrounding unincorporated areas.
